high_level_description: A bright Scandinavian kitchen interior with white cabinets, a pale oak island and copper pendant lamps, morning light.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Open-plan kitchen with white walls, a large window on the left letting in cool morning light, light wooden floorboards.

elements.desc: Long kitchen island with a pale oak top and three copper pendant lamps hanging above it.
Ceramic bowl of green apples and a glass carafe of water standing on the island.
Row of white handleless cabinets along the back wall with a black steel range hood.
Potted fiddle-leaf fig in a woven basket standing in the right corner.
